title: DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16597v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Expressive flow policies can represent multiple high-value actions, but sampling them with few integration steps while retaining tractable action densities remains challenging. We introduce DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that replaces explicit Euler sampling with implicit Euler integration and solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system. We combine implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula for the final-action density, enabling off-policy training within soft actor-critic without backpropagating through solver iterations. DEFlow achieves an average relative improvement of approximately 10% in mean successful coverage over the strongest baseline across four Multi-Goal docking variants. It also achieves the highest mean time-averaged return on four of five manipulation tasks, while remaining broadly competitive across five MuJoCo tasks. These results support implicit flow policies

translated_title: DEFlow：深度均衡流最大熵强化学习
translated_abstract: 表达能力强的流策略能够表示多个高价值动作，但在仅用少量积分步骤进行采样的同时保持动作密度的可处理性仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了DEFlow，一种深度均衡流策略，它用隐式欧拉积分取代显式欧拉采样，并将所有中间动作作为一个均衡系统联合求解。我们将隐式微分与针对最终动作密度的离散变量替换公式相结合，使得能够在软演员-评论家（soft actor-critic）框架内进行离策略训练，而无需通过求解器迭代进行反向传播。在四个多目标对接变体上，DEFlow相对最强基线在平均成功覆盖率上取得了约10%的平均相对提升。它还在五个操作任务中的四个上取得了最高的平均时间平均回报，同时在五个MuJoCo任务中保持广泛的竞争力。这些结果支持了隐式流策略的有效性。
tldr: DEFlow提出了一种深度均衡流策略，通过隐式欧拉积分将所有中间动作作为均衡系统联合求解，并借助隐式微分与离散变量替换公式实现了无需反向传播的离策略训练，在多目标对接、机械臂操作和MuJoCo基准任务上均取得了约10%的平均相对性能提升。
en_tdlr: DEFlow proposes a deep equilibrium flow policy that solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system via implicit Euler integration, and combines implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula to enable off-policy training without backpropagating through solver iterations, achieving approximately 10% average relative improvement across multi-goal docking, manipulation, and MuJoCo benchmarks.
